description: This file defines the 'Country' entity class within the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database columns. It includes properties for country code, name, ISO3 code, and numerical code, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country, with attributes such as country code, name, ISO3 code, and numerical code, mapped to the database table 'hs_hr_country'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country.

methods.name: getIso3
methods.description: Returns the ISO3 code of the country.

methods.name: setIso3
methods.description: Sets the ISO3 code of the country.

methods.name: getNumCode
methods.description: Returns the numerical code of the country.

methods.name: setNumCode
methods.description: Sets the numerical code of the country.
